summary: Cruden 2 is LGC Holdco’s sole manager; the proxy distinguishes management arrangements from Lachlan Murdoch’s narrower appointment rights.

Share-voting and disposition powers must not be generalized to entity-wide control.

summary: Lachlan Murdoch can appoint or replace the Cruden 2 managing director who generally decides voting and disposition of the News Corp shares, subject to specified exceptions.

He disclaims beneficial ownership, although the proxy describes deemed beneficial ownership under securities rules.
